description: Utility functions for managing nodes in a flow-based system, including generating unique IDs and labels, initializing default node data, and creating node output anchors.

methods.name: getUniqueNodeId
methods.description: Generates a unique node ID based on existing nodes and node data.

methods.name: getUniqueNodeLabel
methods.description: Generates a unique label for a node based on existing nodes and node data.

methods.name: initializeDefaultNodeData
methods.description: Initializes default values for node parameters.

methods.name: initNode
methods.description: Initializes a node with proper anchors, default values, and output configuration.
